protocol.group: One shared chronological 70%/15%/remainder event split; all ranks/prefixes grouped
protocol.order: real CN StartAt, then EventID; never shuffled
protocol.rounding: floor train, floor validation, remainder test
protocol.training_sampling: same prescribed origin grid for all three groups
protocol.fit_policy: train only; validation selects checkpoints/recipes; no refit or heat update on validation/test
protocol.exposure: Retained events overlap previously explored training/validation/test cohorts; not unseen data.
protocol.metadata_caveat: Retrospective Bestdori snapshot; no archived point-in-time metadata proof. CN card release times are filtered.
protocol.scope: Same dense V2 cases; expanding completed-event history at event start
protocol.additional_rank_final: last observation no later than end+300s, requiring observation >=end-60s; later polling excluded
protocol.case_key: split/event/rank/requested cutoff; alias stages do not duplicate physical cases
protocol.cohort: exact inherited event and eligible curve lists
protocol.first_experiment: New cohort requires training from its own train group; old model predictions are not transferable
protocol.collection_context: User reports earlier data were manually submitted; excluded by actual event start.
protocol.history_boundary: start >= minimum and end strictly < current event start
protocol.feedback: Earlier validation/test finals permitted only after their prediction seal and completion
protocol.training_evaluation: Initial training group is warmup; validation/test only are scored
